verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the Guichet unique's scope, payment methods, signature requirements and progress tracking. Nothing in it publishes operating hours, per-day filing limits or session timeouts for the online flow. The up-front disclosure of the qualified e-signature requirement is a different prerequisite and does not cover this story's timing and limit disclosures.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
